when: Use when an undocumented mechanism fails specifically as it crosses an interface, version, process, or trust boundary.

members.role: Locate the last valid and first invalid crossing.
Probe and reproduce the hidden mechanism at that crossing.

sequence: Trace one failed traveler across the system.
Select the smallest undocumented boundary that contains the transformation.
Form competing mechanism hypotheses and run a safe differential probe.
Repair the contract or compatibility model with a novel prediction.
